name: mvp02b2-independent-paraphrase-and-correction-v1
description: Real-model review: an independent first-message paraphrase, followed by source-linked, successive frequency corrections. Neither tentative wording nor older cadence may be mistaken for an approved Goal.

steps.text: I've been thinking about walking more regularly.
Actually, twice per week would be better.
Actually, once per week would be better.
What outdoor activity had I been considering?
steps.review_response: Verify sourced walking and all frequency corrections. 'Twice per week would be better' was tentative: reject 'decided twice weekly' or other unsupported commitments. Latest once/week is also a preference, not a finalized plan or approved goal.

steps.text: Do you remember what we discussed about walking?
steps.review_response: Verify source-linked three → twice → once/week corrections. Once weekly is the latest tentative preference, not a settled plan. Avoid 'settled on', 'decided', 'committed' or 'approved goal' without explicit user commitment.

steps.text: What if I wanted to start next month instead?
steps.review_response: A hypothetical is not an approved goal or completed external action; response should be concise and grounded in the actual current topic.
